# The suites that read `.claude/` or `AGENTS.md` (#2712). A change
# confined to those paths runs lint and these suites alone, instead
# of the whole suite and the release build; ci.yml's `changes` job
# picks that lane and `scripts/ci-instruction-filter` turns this
# list into the `swift test --filter` it runs.
#
# Never edited by hand alone: `CiInstructionLaneTests` derives the
# readers from `Tests/` and reds when this list and the tree
# disagree in either direction. A change to this file is outside
# the lane it defines, so it always runs the full suite.
#
# One suite type name per line.

CiPathFilterTests
InstructionPinTests
RuleCitationTests
SubsystemMapParityTests
VerifyGateParityTests
WarningGateTests
WarningRatchetWorkflowTests
